title: Heap and Priority Queue Quiz
description: A quick check to review heaps and priority queues in Python.

questions.questionText: What type of heap does Python's heapq module provide by default?
questions.explanation: Python's heapq module provides a min-heap, where the smallest item is removed first.

questions.questionText: What is the output of the following code?
questions.codeSnippet:
import heapq

heap = []
heapq.heappush(heap, 5)
heapq.heappush(heap, 2)
heapq.heappush(heap, 8)

print(heapq.heappop(heap))
questions.explanation: heapq is a min-heap, so heappop removes and returns the smallest value, which is 2.
